description: Execute GraphQL operations (queries and mutations) against the federated system. WARNING: This tool performs remote operations. 'Mutation' operations will modify persistent state; execute these only when a state change is intended. Prerequisites: Verify schema structure using 'introspect-schema' before executing complex queries. Security: Inherits environment-based authentication. Returns: A JSON object containing the execution result ('data') or a list of 'errors' in case of failure.

endpoint.description: Optional target GraphQL HTTP/HTTPS URL to dynamically switch endpoint before execution.

headers.description: JSON stringified object of extra HTTP headers for the request.

query.description: The GraphQL query or mutation string. Example: 'query { guilds { id name } }'.

variables.description: JSON stringified object of variables. Example: '{"id": "123"}'.

name: query-graphql
